name: York County, NE
findings: York County has 81 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, York County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
